overviews.name: PARTYRSK
key_points: Maintains the party view behind customer accounts - KYC reviews, sanctions screening, exposure and risk scores - in PARTYDB.

Serves card servicing online as a risk service (PRKYC01 for authorisations, PRKYC03 for inquiries) and in batch through PRBRSK1 recalculation, writing a regulatory audit row for every assessment or look.
Runs the weekly PARTYWK cycle: KYC due selection, sanctions feed load and watch-list rebuild, full portfolio rescore and the regulatory audit pack.

descriptions.name: CBPRT01
descriptions.description: PARTYWK step 1: raises pending KYC review rows for parties whose review is due by KYC level and writes the review work list.

descriptions.name: CBPRT02A
descriptions.description: PARTYWK: loads the weekly vendor sanctions feed into PARTYRSK.PARTY_SANCTION after balancing the trailer count.

descriptions.name: CBPRT02B
descriptions.description: PARTYWK: unloads active sanctions rows as the watch-list file for the WATCHLST VSAM rebuild.

descriptions.name: CBPRT03
descriptions.description: PARTYWK step 3: drives every active party through the PRBRSK1 recalculation entry point with checkpoint restart.

descriptions.name: CBPRT04
descriptions.description: PARTYWK step 4: prints the weekly regulatory risk audit pack from PARTY_RISK_AUDIT and supporting tables.

descriptions.name: PRBRSK1
descriptions.description: Batch risk recalculation entry point for one party (KYC/sanctions, exposure, rescore, persist); owns the DB2 unit of work.
key_points: Called by the CARDSVC batch dispatcher on route XMOD/RSKRECAL and by CBPRT03; online callers are rejected with RC 12.

descriptions.name: PRBRSK2
descriptions.description: Batch recalculation step 2: decides whether the KYC review is due and re-screens the party against the watch list.

descriptions.name: PRBRSK3
descriptions.description: Batch recalculation step 3: rebuilds party exposure from PARTY_EXPOSURE plus live CARDSVC.ACCOUNT and CARD_LIMIT balances.

descriptions.name: PRBRSK4
descriptions.description: Batch recalculation step 4: rescores the party against the model parameters held on VSAM RSKPARM.

descriptions.name: PRBRSK5
descriptions.description: Batch recalculation step 5: writes the score, exposure and RCAL audit rows; commits nothing itself.

descriptions.name: PRERR01
descriptions.description: PARTYRSK online error handler: formats the diagnostic to TDQ PRER and a per-task TS queue.

descriptions.name: PRKYC01
descriptions.description: Online risk-service entry point for card authorisations: validates CV-RISK-AREA, resolves the party and drives the assessment chain.
key_points: Reached from CARDSVC only through route XMOD/RISKSVC in CARDSVC.PGM_ROUTE; the card side never names it.

descriptions.name: PRKYC02
descriptions.description: Online KYC status and sanctions screening against the watch list name path.

descriptions.name: PRKYC03
descriptions.description: Online read-only party/KYC inquiry entry point reached from CARDSVC route XMOD/KYCINQ; audits every look.

descriptions.name: PRKYC04
descriptions.description: Online inquiry: assembles the party record, linked customer numbers and last five KYC reviews for the summary.

descriptions.name: PRRSK02
descriptions.description: Online exposure aggregation across product systems, falling back to live CARDSVC.ACCOUNT when the card feed row is absent or stale.

descriptions.name: PRRSK03
descriptions.description: Online risk scoring with model parameters cached from the RSKPARM KSDS per load-module residency.

descriptions.name: PRRSK04
descriptions.description: Online risk decision: turns score, band, KYC and sanctions into advice and writes score and audit rows under the caller's unit of work.

descriptions.name: PRRSK05
descriptions.description: Online inquiry bottom: returns the latest risk score and exposure totals and records the regulatory access row.

descriptions.name: BINDCARD
descriptions.description: Binds every CARDSVC package into collection CARDCOLL and the four card application plans.

descriptions.name: BINDPRTY
descriptions.description: Binds every PARTYRSK package into collection PRTYCOLL and the two Party & Risk plans; must run before BINDCARD.

descriptions.name: BUILDALL
descriptions.description: Full rebuild of the card estate from source: assembler, CICS and batch COBOL members of both modules.

descriptions.name: CBPRT01J
descriptions.description: PARTYWK job 1 of 4: runs CBPRT01 KYC review due selection.

descriptions.name: CBPRT02J
descriptions.description: PARTYWK job 2 of 4: loads the sanctions feed (CBPRT02A) and rebuilds the WATCHLST VSAM from it (CBPRT02B, sort, repro, BLDINDEX).

descriptions.name: CBPRT03J
descriptions.description: PARTYWK job 3 of 4: runs CBPRT03 full portfolio rescore.

descriptions.name: CBPRT04J
descriptions.description: PARTYWK job 4 of 4: prints the weekly regulatory risk audit pack.

descriptions.name: CSDUPCRD
descriptions.description: Applies the card servicing CICS resource definitions to the CSD of production region CICSCARD via DFHCSDUP.

descriptions.name: DEFCARD
descriptions.description: Install job that defines the CARDSVC VSAM clusters.

descriptions.name: DEFPARTY
descriptions.description: Install job that defines the PARTYRSK VSAM clusters under their own HLQ.

descriptions.name: DEFPWCTL
descriptions.description: Install job that defines the PARTYWK cycle control VSAM cluster.

descriptions.name: COBASM
descriptions.description: PROC that assembles and links the HLASM subroutine as a separate load module for static inclusion by COBOL link edits.

descriptions.name: COBBATCH
descriptions.description: PROC that precompiles, compiles and link-edits batch COBOL programs (no CICS translate), CALLOPT selecting DYNAM or NODYNAM.

descriptions.name: COBCICS
descriptions.description: PROC that translates, precompiles, compiles and link-edits CICS/DB2 online COBOL programs.
